page.overview:
Who is Mouth Devil?

The の|Kuchi no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of mouths.

The Mouth Devil possesses an appearance similar to that of an octopus with tongue-like tentacles with teeth arranged like suckers on them.

When Yoru forces the Chainsaw Devil to spit out the Mouth Devil's head, it is revealed to have two white eyes and a mouth with two mouths inside of each other, as well as another mouth on top of it.

The Mouth Devil's personality is currently unknown.
